notesEn.ABW: Same-sex marriage since 2024-07-12: the Supreme Court of the Netherlands upheld the Joint Court of Justice ruling that the ban was unconstitutional; registered partnerships since 2021; From 2007: recognition of same-sex marriages performed elsewhere in the Kingdom of the Netherlands (Supreme Court ruling of April 2007); registered partnerships from 2021.
notesEn.ALA: Same-sex marriage since 2017-03-01: amended Marriage Act (a citizens' initiative); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.AND: Same-sex marriage since 2023-02-17: 2022 amendment to the marriage law; From 2005: stable unions (civil unions from 2014).
notesEn.ARG: Same-sex marriage since 2010-07-22: Law 26.618 (Equal Marriage Act).
notesEn.ASM: Since 2022: same-sex marriages are not performed, but those from elsewhere are recognised under the US Respect for Marriage Act of 2022.
notesEn.AUS: Same-sex marriage since 2017-12-09: Marriage Amendment (Definition and Religious Freedoms) Act 2017, after a national postal survey; federal law had recognised same-sex de facto couples since 2009 and some states had relationship registers.
notesEn.AUT: Same-sex marriage since 2019-01-01: Constitutional Court ruling of December 2017; From 2010: registered partnerships.
notesEn.BEL: Same-sex marriage since 2003-06-01: Law of 13 February 2003; From 2000: statutory cohabitation.
notesEn.BES: Same-sex marriage since 2012-10-10: Dutch marriage law extended to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba; From 2012: registered partnerships.
notesEn.BLM: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; From 1999: civil solidarity pacts (PACS); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.BMU: Domestic partnerships (Domestic Partnership Act 2018); same-sex marriage was opened by a court ruling in May 2017 and ended by the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council in March 2022, though marriages performed before then remain valid.
notesEn.BOL: Since 2023: free unions (Plurinational Constitutional Tribunal ruling, nationwide from March 2023).
notesEn.BRA: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-16: Resolution 175 of the National Justice Council (the Supreme Federal Court recognised same-sex stable unions in 2011); From 2011: stable unions (Supreme Federal Court ruling).
notesEn.CAN: Same-sex marriage since 2005-07-20: Civil Marriage Act; Ontario and other provinces had allowed it by court rulings since 2003.
notesEn.CCK: Same-sex marriage since 2017-12-09: Marriage Amendment (Definition and Religious Freedoms) Act 2017, after a national postal survey; federal law had recognised same-sex de facto couples since 2009 and some states had relationship registers; the same law as the sovereign country applies.

notesEn.CHL: Same-sex marriage since 2022-03-10: Law 21.400; From 2015: civil union agreements.
notesEn.COL: Same-sex marriage since 2016-04-28: Constitutional Court ruling SU-214/2016; From 2009: de facto marital unions.

notesEn.GGY: Same-sex marriage since 2017-05-02: Guernsey; Alderney from 2018 and Sark from 2020.
notesEn.GIB: Same-sex marriage since 2016-12-15: Civil Marriage Amendment Act 2016; civil partnerships since 2014; From 2014: civil partnerships.
notesEn.GLP: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; From 1999: civil solidarity pacts (PACS); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.GRC: Same-sex marriage since 2024-02-16: Law 5089/2024; From 2015: cohabitation agreements.
notesEn.GRL: Same-sex marriage since 2016-04-01: Danish marriage law extended to Greenland; From 1996: registered partnerships.
notesEn.GUF: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; From 1999: civil solidarity pacts (PACS); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.GUM: Same-sex marriage since 2015-06-26: Supreme Court ruling in Obergefell v. Hodges; Massachusetts was the first state, in 2004; the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.HKG: No civil unions or marriage; court rulings have granted same-sex couples some rights (spousal visas, civil servants' spousal benefits and others), and the Court of Final Appeal ordered the government in September 2023 to create a partnership framework within two years.
notesEn.IMN: Same-sex marriage since 2016-07-22: Marriage and Civil Partnership (Amendment) Act 2016; civil partnerships since 2011; From 2011: civil partnerships.
notesEn.IRL: Same-sex marriage since 2015-11-16: Marriage Act 2015, after the May 2015 referendum; From 2011: civil partnerships.
notesEn.ISL: Same-sex marriage since 2010-06-27: amended Marriage Act; From 1996: registered partnerships.
notesEn.ISR: Since 2006: recognition of same-sex marriages performed abroad (High Court of Justice ruling of November 2006); there is no domestic civil marriage.
notesEn.JEY: Same-sex marriage since 2018-07-01: Marriage and Civil Status (Amendment) Law 2018; civil partnerships since 2012; From 2012: civil partnerships.
notesEn.JPN: No nationwide legal recognition; most prefectures and hundreds of municipalities issue partnership certificates without the legal effect of marriage, and several high courts have ruled the marriage ban unconstitutional.
notesEn.LIE: Same-sex marriage since 2025-01-01: amended Marriage Act; From 2011: registered partnerships.
notesEn.LTU: Since 2025: partnerships registered through the courts (Constitutional Court ruling of April 2025; parliament has not yet legislated).
notesEn.LUX: Same-sex marriage since 2015-01-01: Law of 4 July 2014; From 2004: registered partnerships.
notesEn.MAF: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; From 1999: civil solidarity pacts (PACS); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.MEX: Same-sex marriage since 2022-12-31: opened state by state, the last (Guerrero) at the end of 2022; Mexico City was the first, in 2010, and Supreme Court jurisprudence from 2015 required every state to allow it.
notesEn.MLT: Same-sex marriage since 2017-09-01: Marriage Act and other Laws (Amendment) Act 2017; From 2014: civil unions.
notesEn.MNP: Same-sex marriage since 2015-06-26: Supreme Court ruling in Obergefell v. Hodges; Massachusetts was the first state, in 2004; the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.MTQ: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; From 1999: civil solidarity pacts (PACS); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.MYT: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.NCL: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; From 2009: civil solidarity pacts (PACS); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.NFK: Same-sex marriage since 2017-12-09: Marriage Amendment (Definition and Religious Freedoms) Act 2017, after a national postal survey; federal law had recognised same-sex de facto couples since 2009 and some states had relationship registers; the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.NLD: Same-sex marriage since 2001-04-01: Act on the Opening Up of Marriage; the first country in the world; From 1998: registered partnerships.
notesEn.NOR: Same-sex marriage since 2009-01-01: amended Marriage Act; From 1993: registered partnerships.
notesEn.NPL: Same-sex marriage since 2026-06-18: Supreme Court final verdict (Pinky Gurung case) ordering the government to fully recognise same-sex marriage; marriages had been entered in a separate register under an interim order since November 2023, and the Civil Code has not yet been amended.
notesEn.NZL: Same-sex marriage since 2013-08-19: Marriage (Definition of Marriage) Amendment Act 2013; not in the Cook Islands, Niue or Tokelau; From 2005: civil unions.
notesEn.PCN: Same-sex marriage since 2015-05-14: amended Marriage Ordinance.
notesEn.POL: Since 2026: recognition only of same-sex marriages performed in other EU member states (Supreme Administrative Court ruling of March 2026); there is no domestic partnership scheme.
notesEn.PRI: Same-sex marriage since 2015-06-26: Supreme Court ruling in Obergefell v. Hodges; Massachusetts was the first state, in 2004; the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.PRT: Same-sex marriage since 2010-06-05: Law 9/2010; From 2001: legal recognition of de facto unions.
notesEn.PYF: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.REU: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; From 1999: civil solidarity pacts (PACS); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.SHN: Same-sex marriage since 2017-12-20: Saint Helena marriage ordinance; Ascension from January 2017 and Tristan da Cunha from August 2017.
notesEn.SJM: Same-sex marriage since 2009-01-01: amended Marriage Act; the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.SPM: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; From 1999: civil solidarity pacts (PACS); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.SVN: Same-sex marriage since 2022-07-09: Constitutional Court ruling; From 2006: registered partnerships.
notesEn.SWE: Same-sex marriage since 2009-05-01: amended Marriage Code; From 1995: registered partnerships.
notesEn.SXM: Since 2007: recognition of same-sex marriages performed elsewhere in the Kingdom of the Netherlands (Supreme Court ruling of April 2007); same-sex couples cannot yet marry there.
notesEn.THA: Same-sex marriage since 2025-01-23: amended Civil and Commercial Code (Marriage Equality Act), the first in Southeast Asia.
notesEn.TWN: Same-sex marriage since 2019-05-24: Act for Implementation of J.Y. Interpretation No. 748, the first in Asia; most cities and counties had offered same-sex partnership notations without legal effect from 2015.
notesEn.URY: Same-sex marriage since 2013-08-05: Law 19.075; From 2008: concubinary unions.
notesEn.USA: Same-sex marriage since 2015-06-26: Supreme Court ruling in Obergefell v. Hodges; Massachusetts was the first state, in 2004.
notesEn.VIR: Same-sex marriage since 2015-06-26: Supreme Court ruling in Obergefell v. Hodges; Massachusetts was the first state, in 2004; the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.WLF: Same-sex marriage since 2013-05-18: Law 2013-404 (Mariage pour tous), also applying in the overseas departments and territories; From 2009: civil solidarity pacts (PACS); the same law as the sovereign country applies.
notesEn.ZAF: Same-sex marriage since 2006-11-30: Civil Union Act, 2006.
notesEn._IOT: Same-sex marriage since 2017-12-09: Marriage Amendment (Definition and Religious Freedoms) Act 2017, after a national postal survey; federal law had recognised same-sex de facto couples since 2009 and some states had relationship registers; the same law as the sovereign country applies.
